Much of the economy is also being powered by the wealth effect of higher stock prices,
the phenomenon in which people spend more because they feel wealthy when the stock market is booming.
US households held $55.1 trillion in stocks and mutual fund shares in the first quarter, accounting for over 30% of all wealth held by households in the US, according to the latest Fed data.
